title: Pear and Tiropita Mexican Dessert
description: A unique dessert combining the sweetness of pear and the creaminess of tiropita, inspired by Mexican flavors.

ingredients.name: Crust
ingredients.amount: 1 sheet of frozen puff pastry, thawed

instructions: Roll out the puff pastry to a thickness of 1/8 inch.
In a bowl, mix together tiropita cheese, cinnamon, and a pinch of sugar.
Arrange the pear slices on one half of the pastry, leaving a 1/2 inch border.
Spread the tiropita cheese mixture over the pear.
Fold the other half of the pastry over the filling and press edges to seal.
Brush the pastry with lime juice and sprinkle with agave syrup.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown.
